title: Three criteria, two chairs
caption: Groupwise calibration, balance in the positive class, and balance in the negative class: with unequal base rates and imperfect prediction, at most two of the three can hold. The worked-example numbers annotate each edge.

title: Deferred work relocates
caption: Explanation work deferred after deployment does not vanish; it moves onto the serial request path, the memory budget, or a human review queue. Capacity multiples preserve throughput, never serial latency.

title: The retraining feedback loop
caption: Biased outputs shape behavior and future data collection; retraining on that data deepens the bias. Positive loop gain makes the unconstrained pipeline a divergent amplifier.

title: The assurance chain
caption: Claim, argument, evidence, owner, action. A dashboard feeds the evidence link only; without the owner and the action path it is a log entry, not a control.
